content.name: Universal Solvent
entries: This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. You can use an action to pour the contents of the tube onto a surface within reach. The liquid instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including {@item sovereign glue}.

content.name: Universal Solvent
entries: This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains {@dice 1d6 + 1} ounces.

You can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.
